scope: GitHub Windows runner source build and native authorization, input-guard lifecycle and worker IPC tests
limitations: Historical development build; subsequent source and dependency changes require a new build.
Build duration includes source setup, compilation, licensing and automated checks, not just compiler execution.
Free space is the initial observation and the configured minimum, not peak build disk usage.
No real keyboard or pointer injection, browser interoperability, physical GPU, installation, clipboard or cross-network acceptance is established.
